jobs.description: Front Line Support Engineer - East Coast (US) | Fireblocks United States Front Line Support Engineer – East Coast Apply Now Fireblocks is the company bringing global finance onchain. Backed by over $1 billion in capital, we are the premier digital asset infrastructure provider trusted by thousands of industry-defining financial institutions, including banks, payment providers, fintechs, and global corporates such as BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Western Union, Stripe, and Revolut. Built for institutional scale and security, our enterprise-grade platform and network have powered over $14 trillion in digital asset transfers worldwide. What You’ll Do Join our mission to deliver unparalleled customer support in the dynamic world of cryptocurrency and DeFi. As a Customer Frontline Support Engineer, you will act as the first point of contact for our customers, resolving complex issues with empathy, precision, and urgency. You’ll be instrumental in ensuring our customers succeed, collaborating with internal teams to deliver proactive, world-class support. This role is intended to work US-Eastern hours and operates on a 24/7 schedule including weekends and holidays to meet customer needs, with shifts determined based on seniority and business requirements. The hired candidate will ultimately work a fixed schedule consisting of: Monday through Friday: 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM (US-Eastern) Candidates may also be required to work weekend shifts as business needs dictate, following either a Tuesday through Saturday or Sunday through Thursday schedule (with hours to be confirmed based on the assigned rotation). *Please note that these hours are subject to change based on business needs, with or without advance notice. Training Period: All new hires will initially undergo training Monday through Friday during standard US-Eastern business hours. During the training period, which may last approximately 90 to 180 days depending on individual progress and proficiency with the platform, candidates may occasionally be scheduled for rotating weekend shifts (Saturday or Sunday, 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM US-Eastern) as part of their onboarding and readiness preparation. Upon successful completion of training, the employee will transition to the assigned Wednesday through Sunday schedule listed above. Responsibilities Serve as a trusted advisor and advocate for customers, managing inquiries with empathy and efficiency. Provide real-time support via Slack and other communication tools, ensuring timely and accurate resolutions. Deliver outstanding technical support for Fireblocks’ SaaS platform, going above and beyond to address customer needs. Escalate and collaborate on complex issues with the Senior Support Team, ensuring seamless resolution and customer satisfaction. Proactively identify and resolve recurring issues, contributing to process improvements and enhancing the customer experience. Manage cases meticulously, maintaining clear and detailed documentation throughout the support process. Communicate effectively during critical incidents, participating in “war room” calls and keeping customers informed with timely updates. Embrace and adhere to business processes and policies while suggesting improvements to enhance the customer journey. Required Skills 1 – 2 years of experience in a customer support or similar role, with a passion for delivering exceptional service. Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to work under pressure and prioritize customer needs effectively. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, demonstrating professionalism and empathy in all interactions. Proven ability to build strong relationships with customers, acting as a trusted advisor and advocate for their needs. A customer-first mindset, ensuring that resolutions align with customer success and satisfaction. Demonstrated experience in managing and resolving complex issues with a proactive and collaborative approach. Ability to adapt quickly to changing customer needs and prioritize tasks to meet expectations. Commitment to continuous learning and staying updated on the latest industry trends and technologies. Nice-to-Have Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience. Previous experience supporting SaaS-based solutions or working in the financial services or technology sectors. Familiarity with databases, scripting languages (Python, JavaScript, etc.), and tools like Coralogix, Kibana, Grafana, and LogStash. Understanding of blockchain technologies and cryptographic principles used in public blockchain networks. Proven ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment to solve customer challenges. It is not typical for a candidate to be hired at or near the top of the pay range and each compensation decision is dependent on each individual case. A reasonable base salary range estimate for this position is $90,000 to $95,000. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which for some roles may include a target bonus, a very competitive equity grant, and very generous benefits. While we believe competitive compensation is a critical aspect of you deciding to join us, we do hope you also spend time considering why our mission and culture are right for you. We are creating something transformational here, and we hope you are as excited about the future as we are. Senior Accountant — Israel We’re hiring a Senior Accountant, based in Israel, to own accounting, financial reporting, and statutory and tax compliance. Reporting to the Accounting Director, this is a hands-on role combining execution and ownership: closing the books under US GAAP, preparing statutory accounts, managing indirect tax and supporting direct tax, owning the vendor and AP cycle, leading the local audit, and partnering with the global finance team on group reporting. We’re looking for someone hungry — ambitious, curious, and here to build, not just maintain. You’ll be: Own end-to-end accounting and financial reporting in accordance with US GAAP and Fireblocks group accounting policies, and lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual close on group deadlines — general ledger integrity, balance sheet reconciliations, cut-off journals, accruals and prepayments, and flux analysis with clear explanations of the drivers. Own the end-to-end Accounts Payable cycle: vendor onboarding, invoice processing, approval workflow, payment runs, AP-to-GL reconciliation, and AP aging and accrual completeness at close. Oversee daily banking operations performed by the bookkeeping team — reviewing bank and credit card reconciliations and employee expense claims, monitoring the cash position, and supporting treasury on funding and payment execution. Own intercompany balances and recharges across group entities, including monthly reconciliation, settlement, and support for consolidation eliminations. Prepare Israeli statutory financial statements, including the bridge from US GAAP to the statutory basis, and manage the external audit end-to-end. Support Israeli direct tax compliance in partnership with the Group Tax Director and external advisors: annual corporate tax return, tax reconciliation, advance payments (mikdamot), and Israeli Tax Authority inquiries and audits. Own Israeli indirect tax and withholding compliance: VAT reporting and reconciliation, monthly and annual withholding reports, withholding certificates, and treaty-based withholding on cross-border payments. Review monthly payroll, including statutory contributions, pension and keren hishtalmut, severance provisions, payroll journals, and reconciliation to the GL. Own the finance systems landscape — NetSuite, Coupa, and banking platforms — safeguarding data integrity and driving configuration and process improvements as the business scales. Identify and implement opportunities to streamline and automate accounting processes using AI tools, and help set the standard for how the team uses them. Review and guide the bookkeeping team’s day-to-day work, setting priorities and holding the quality bar on accuracy and timeliness. Partner with the global finance team, cross-functional stakeholders, and external vendors and advisors to support business operations and finance initiatives. Lead ad hoc accounting projects as needed. You’ll bring: Israeli CPA — required. Big 4 background — required, with hi-tech audit experience. 3–5 years post-internship experience, ideally in-house at global SaaS or tech companies. Deep understanding of US GAAP, with hands-on ownership of month-end close and group reporting. Deep understanding of Israeli taxation, direct and indirect — corporate tax, VAT, and withholding. Experience preparing Israeli statutory financial statements and managing external audits end-to-end. Hands-on NetSuite experience across core accounting modules (GL, AP, banking). Highly proficient in Microsoft Excel. AI and process optimization — knowledge and proven experience adopting and integrating AI tools into daily workflows, with curiosity to explore new applications as they emerge. Experience in a high-growth tech or fintech environment, with the ability to work in ambiguity and build processes from the ground up. Comfortable managing multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Ownership — reliable, independent, and a pusher, with the interpersonal skills to drive items to closure across teams and external providers. Strong written and verbal communication skills in Hebrew and English, with experience working across cultures and time zones in a globally distributed team. Play a mentorship role to team members, constantly promoting improvement in their professional skills. Provide self-service capabilities in order to empower the business’s software engineering teams. Define tasks aimed at reducing/eliminating any repetitive or manual tasks and assist with prioritization. Work with other infra teams on improving health and performance issues of the system. Play a strategic role in designing and building infrastructure for ensuring the highest levels of security and responding swiftly to any new and emerging vulnerabilities and security threats. Actively hands-on on projects and tasks. What will you bring to the role? At least 4 years experience leading a DevOps team. At least 5 years of working experience in a DevOps capacity, working within a fast-paced and fast-evolving SaaS environment. At least 5 years of experience with cloud providers - AWS/Azure. At least 10 years of experience in high-tech companies in DevOps roles or similar positions (such as software engineer, system administrator, automation engineer etc) Proficiency in Linux, Command Line, Git, and CI. Experience in the automation, configuration, and application performance management tools such as Ansible/Chef/Puppet, and Datadog/Prometheus/Grafana. Experience with GitOps methodology and supporting tools. Experience with GitLab Pipelines. AI based mindset - creation of agents and skills to reduce constant workload. Strong system-level troubleshooting skills and ability to identify and resolve high-level scalability, performance issues and complex problems. Strong communication skills in a highly collaborative environment. Advantages: BSC in Computer Science or related technical certificate. Background in software development. FinOps experience. jobs.title: Staff Engineer, AI Platform
jobs.location: Tel Aviv-Yafo, Tel Aviv District, Israel
jobs.description: Fireblocks is the company bringing global finance onchain. Backed by over $1 billion in capital, we are the premier digital asset infrastructure provider trusted by thousands of industry-defining financial institutions, including banks, payment providers, fintechs, and global corporates such as BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Western Union, Stripe, and Revolut. Built for institutional scale and security, our enterprise-grade platform and network have powered over $14 trillion in digital asset transfers worldwide. Staff Engineer, AI Platform The world of digital assets is accelerating in speed, magnitude, and complexity, opening the door to new ways of leveraging the blockchain. Fireblocks' platform and network provide the simplest and most secure way for companies to work with digital assets, and it's trusted by some of the largest financial institutions, banks, globally-recognized brands, and Web3 companies in the world, including BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Revolut, and thousands more. Founded in 2018 and already valued at over $8 billion, Fireblocks is a SaaS platform that helps companies create innovative products on the blockchain and manage day-to-day crypto operations. We have offices in New York, London, Tel Aviv, and Singapore, and we are continuing to expand our teams to reach new customers globally. What You'll Do You'll own our internal AI platform — the shared foundation teams across the company rely on to build and run AI-powered tools securely and at scale. This is a hands-on Staff-level role: you'll architect and write production code, own the roadmap, and keep the platform reliable, secure, and easy to build on as it serves the entire organization. Beyond the platform itself, you'll help drive an AI mindset across the company — spotting where AI creates real leverage, setting technical direction, and raising the bar for how teams build with it. Doing that well means working like a product owner as much as an engineer: proactively engaging stakeholders across engineering, product, go-to-market, and operations, turning what they need into a clear plan, and communicating it credibly all the way up to the executive level. What You'll Bring Vast, Staff-level engineering experience. A long track record building and running high-scale systems, still deeply hands-on with the code. Real AI experience and mindset. Genuine command of how modern AI systems are built — frontier-model APIs, multi-agent orchestration, RAG, and the surfaces developers build against, from CLIs to MCP — plus the instinct for where AI creates leverage. Product sense and proactive communication. You work like a product owner as much as an engineer — finding stakeholders, shaping what they need into a roadmap, and communicating it clearly from whiteboard to executive level. Model routing and gateway experience. You've built or run a gateway that routes inference across providers on cost, latency, capability, and data sensitivity. Measuring and improving AI systems. Comfort with unpredictable outputs — telling whether a change helped, catching regressions, and keeping quality, cost, and safety in check. Security-first by design. You treat a high security bar as a design principle, not an afterthought — guardrails, least-privilege access, human-in-the-loop escalation, monitoring, and audit for autonomous systems. Solid DevOps foundation. Comfortable owning the infra too — cloud, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and IaC — with a healthy security posture. Cross-functional influence. You lead through ownership, partnering closely with security, legal, and finance. Advantages Background in a high-trust, regulated environment (fintech, security, or custody) where data sensitivity, auditability, and reliability are first-order concerns. A feel for how large organizations work — navigating many stakeholders, competing priorities, and cross-team dependencies to get a platform adopted at scale. Experience with digital assets, blockchain, or Web3 — familiarity with the domain Fireblocks operates in. If you're an experienced engineer and a genuine AI expert who wants to shape how an entire company builds with AI — come and join us. Fireblocks' mission is to enable every business to easily and securely access digital assets and cryptocurrencies. In order to do that, we strongly believe our workforce should be as diverse as our clients, and this is why we embrace diversity and inclusion in all its forms.
